findingRules.dead: no core outcome resolved in any group at any step
findingRules.intendedMiss: the largest elasticity on an intended outcome is under 0.05, or nothing resolved on it
findingRules.sideEffect: an outcome the lever is not for moves with an elasticity of 0.5 or more (damage, kills, damage taken, XP, XP after deaths, gold in, the store bill, supplies. All cells). Damage, kills, XP and gold in count as one thing for a lever that is for any of them
findingRules.byLevel: for a rate outcome, the high-step elasticity differs between two Levels by more than 0.3 and by more than a factor of two, or changes sign, both resolved
findingRules.byStyle: at one step the outcome rises for one lone way and falls for another, both resolved and both past 2% (300 gold an hour for net gold)
findingRules.redundant: two levers whose effect vectors (every cell, every core rate outcome, lowest and highest step) have a cosine of 0.9 or more, or -0.9 or less
findingRules.nonlinear: the low-step and high-step elasticities differ by 0.25 or more and by 30% of the larger, both resolved

elastShape: elast[lever][group][outcome] = [low, local, high], resolved core outcomes only
detail: every group and every experiment table is printed from data/parts (--lever, --exp, --md, --md-lever, --md-exp): it is not stored twice
